title: Cumrige automatic litter box,Safety Sensor,App Control,95L Large Capacity
say: Customers love this automatic litter box for its self-cleaning mechanism that works flawlessly, surprising quiet operation, and effective odor control. They find it easy to use, with cats taking to it quickly, and consider it good value for money. The reliability and durability receive mixed feedback - while some report no issues, others mention it constantly stops running and the bottom lining tears after about two months of use.
